exercises.why: **говорил** — говори́ть (imperfective): to speak, to talk (perfective поговорить); to say, to tell (perfective сказать).
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Tom and Mary talked all night.
exercises.why: **проговорили** — проговори́ть (perfective): to say, to utter; to talk (for a while). Wiktionary: про- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: We spoke for about three hours.
exercises.why: **проговорили** — проговори́ть (perfective): to say, to utter; to talk (for a while). Wiktionary: про- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **заговорил** — заговори́ть (perfective): to begin to speak; to talk someone's ear off (tire someone out by one's talk); to exorcise, to bewitch, to charm, to cast a spell, to enchant. Wiktionary: за- + говори́ть.

exercises.q: Tom's last name is hard to pronounce.
exercises.why: **выговорить** — вы́говорить (perfective): to articulate, to pronounce, to utter; (colloquial) to reserve for oneself, to stipulate, to set as a condition (in a contract, transaction, etc.); (colloquial) to censure, to reprimand, to rebuke. Wiktionary: вы́- + говори́ть.
